name: placement-retained-views-cold-unload
description: A placement of a record without surfaces sends an empty request for the undrawn record, and the drawn record presents that request without a second request, because the memory saver classified the cold view as unloaded and no view was mounted.
reason: The case holds the calls setTheme, compositionDeclare, syncSurfaces and presentSurfaces of a window, and the Go producer runs only the log and workspace calls without a window (docs/spec/cases/page-wire/README.md#producer-runs).
